remarks: Cute-n-cozy smaller home that with some imagination and a bit of work will be adorable!! As you                                                        go in through the front you will find a large family room with sliding glass doors to the deep back yard complete with covered patio and storage shed! A formal front living room is great for quiet times and reading and the dining room offers eating space or an area for desk and laptop, gaming area or a gathering area for toys, backpacks or doing schoolwork. The good sized kitchen overlooks the patio and backyard and has built in wall oven, gas cooktop and plenty of cupboards and counter space. Upstairs are 2 bedrooms. This home has a basement that offers an area for utilities, laundry area and storage. Cosmetics are needed such as paint and new floor coverings as older carpet is still present. Great price that will most likely cost you less to own than you pay to rent! For those not wanting a big house with large rambling rooms, this littler home offers efficiency and low cost living!! Good buy!!!
